_note: Mirrors the reference's ARCANE_ASSEMBLER infusion: catalyst ae2:molecular_assembler, instability 5, aspects CRAFT 64 / EXCHANGE 32 / AURA 16 / MAGIC 16 / METAL 8 / CRYSTAL 8, and the six primal shards plus a wand.
_wand: The reference's eighth component is a full-vis scepter, which has no Neo equivalent - a wand is a single thaumaturge:wand carrying a thaumaturge:wand_parts component. All three of that component's fields are pinned, including sceptre, because a partial match is not guaranteed: CraftTweaker dumps the real stack as {sceptre: true, rod: "thaumaturge:silverwood", cap: "thaumaturge:thaumium"}.
_shards: Full crystals, not shards. The reference names thaumcraft:*_shard, which is the 1.7.10 naming, but Thaumaturge's own infusions use the crystal items - elemental_pickaxe takes thaumaturge:crystal_ignis - so this matches them. Those recipes also never component-match an ingredient, so plain items keep this the same shape as the ones already known to work in JEI and at the altar.
